newsitem.title: DENMARK: Capel downgrades top two Danish banks to 'sell'.
newsitem.headline: Capel downgrades top two Danish banks to 'sell'.

text.p: British investment bank James Capel has downgraded its recommendations for Den Danske Bank and Unidanmark to 'sell' from 'buy', saying both underperformed the local market in 1996.
"We expect this underperformance to continue as competition increases in the domestic market," said a James Capel report received by Reuters on Wednesday.
It forecast end-1996 share values of 388 crowns for Den Danske Bank and 271 for Unidanmark. Den Danske traded at 424 crowns on Wednesday, while Unidanmark was already down to 272 crowns.
